items.text: Jehova Nyasaye ogolo chik ne Joshua
Kane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye osetho, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua wuod Nun, jakony Musa niya,
Musa jatichna osetho. Omiyo sani, in kod jogi duto, ikreuru mondo ungʼad Aora Jordan e piny makoro achiegni miyo jo-Israel.
Kamoro amora ma tiendu nonyon anamiu, kaka nasingora ni Musa.
Gwengʼi nochakre e kuonde motwo nyaka Lebanon, kendo koa e aora maduongʼ, ma en Yufrate; piny mar jo-Hiti duto; nyaka chop e Nam Mediterania mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.
Onge ngʼama noloyi e ndalo duto mar ngimani. Kaka ne an kod Musa, bende e kaka abiro bedo kodi; ok anaweyi kata jwangʼi.
"Bed motegno kendo gi chir; nikech ibiro telone jogi nyaka e piny mar girkeni mane akwongʼora ni kweregi ni namigi.
Bed motegno kendo gi chir mogundho. Bed motangʼ mondo iluor chike duto mane jatichna Musa omiyi; kik ilokri korachwich kata koracham kiweyo chikegi, mano nomi ibed gi hawi kamoro amora midhiye.
Kik iwe Kitabu mar Chikni oa e dhogi; par wechene matut odiechiengʼ kod otieno, mondo mi ibed motangʼ kitimo gik moko duto mondik e iye. Mano biro miyo ibedo gi hawi e gimoro amora mitimo.
Par kaka asechiki. Bed motegno kendo gi chir. Kik iluor kendo kik chunyi nyosre; nikech an Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi abiro bedo kodi kamoro amora midhiye."
Omiyo Joshua nochiwo chik ni jotend Israel niya,

"Dhiuru e kambi kendo unyis ji ni, 'Ikuru gigeu mag lweny. Ndalo adek koa kawuono ubiro kalo aora Jordan gikae mondo udhi kendo ukaw mwandu mar piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kaka maru owuon.' "
To joka Reuben, gi joka Gad kod nus mar dhood joka Manase, Joshua nowachonegi niya,
"Paruru chike mane Musa jatich mar Jehova Nyasaye nomiyou, kowacho ni: 'Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu miyou kar yweyo kendo osechiwonu pinyni.'

Mondeu, nyithindu kod kweth mag jambu nyalo dak e piny mane Musa omiyou yo ka wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, makmana jou makedo duto, moikore gi gige lweny, nyaka uidh loka kutelo e nyim oweteu ma jo-Israel. Konyuru oweteu,

nyaka Jehova Nyasaye migi yweyo, mana kaka osetimoni, kendo nyaka gin bende gikaw mwandu mar piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu dhi miyogi. Bangʼ mano, unyalo dok kendo udagie pinyu owuon, mane Musa, jatich Jehova Nyasaye nomiyou bath aora Jordan ma yo wuok chiengʼ."
Eka negidwoko Joshua niya, "Gimoro amora misechikowa wabiro timo, kendo kamoro amora mi iorowae wabiro dhiyoe.
Mana kaka ne waluoro Musa, bende e kaka wabiro luoroi. Mad Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu bed kodi kaka nobedo gi Musa.
Ngʼato angʼata modagi winjo wachni kendo ok oluoro wecheni bende ok odewo chike mimiyogi, ibiro negi. Bed mana motegno kendo jachir!"

items.text: Rahab kod joma oor mondo odhi onon piny

Bangʼe Joshua wuod Nun nooro jonon piny ariyo lingʼ-lingʼ moa Shitim. Nowachonegi niya, "Dhiuru, ungʼi pinyni, to moloyo Jeriko." Omiyo negidhi ma gidonjo e od dhako moro mandhaga ma nyinge Rahab, mi gidak kanyo.
Ruodh Jeriko nonyisi niya, "Ngʼe ni jo-Israel moko osebiro ka gotienoni mondo onon pinywa."
Omiyo ruodh Jeriko nooro wach ni Rahab niya, "Gol oko jogo mane obiro iri kendo odonjo e odi, nikech gisebiro mondo gitim nonro ma lingʼ-lingʼ e pinyni duto."
Kata kamano, Rahab nosekawo ji ariyogi kendo opandogi. Nowacho niya, "En adier, ni jogi nobiro ira, to ne ok angʼeyo ni gia kanye.
E seche mag angʼich welo, e sa michiegoe dhoranga dala maduongʼ, jogi nowuok. Ok angʼeyo yo mane gidhiyoe. Ringuru bangʼ-gi piyo. Unyalo makogi."
To chutho, noyudo ka osepando jogi ewi tado e bwo othith mane opedhi ewi tado kanyo.
Omiyo oganda mar ruodh pinyno nowuok piyo ka gilawogi e yo mochiko aora Jordan, kendo mana gisano ka jogo mane lawogi nosewuok oko, dhorangajno nolor.
Kane jonon pinygo ne pok odhi nindo, dhakoni noidho modhi ewi tado,
kendo mowachonegi niya, "Angʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou pinyni kendo mano osemiyo luoro omako ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomwa, omiyo joma odak e pinyni kihondko osemako nikech un.

Wasewinjo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo pi Nam Makwar oduono kane uwuok e piny Misri, kendo gima ne utimone Sihon kod Og, ruodhi ariyo mag jo-Amor modak yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, mane uketho chuth.
Kane wawinjo wachno, to kihondko nomakowa kendo chir duto mane ngʼato angʼata nigo norumo nikech un, kendo nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en Nyasaye manie polo malo kendo e piny mwalo.
"Kuom mano, kwongʼrenauru gi Jehova Nyasaye ni ubiro ngʼwonone jooda, nikech an bende asetimonu ngʼwono. Singrenauru
ni ubiro ngʼwonone wuonwa kod minwa, owetena kod nyiminena, kod jogegi duto, kendo ni ubiro resowa mondo kik watho."
Jogi nowachone adier niya, "Ngimau en ngimawa! Ka ok uwacho gino ma watimo, to wabiro bedo kodu gi ngʼwono kod ratiro e ndalo ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiwa pinyni."
Omiyo nolorogi piny gi tol ka giluwo dirisa, nikech ot mane odakie ne ochwogi e kor ohinga mar dala maduongʼ.
E sa onogo nowachonegi niya, "Dhiuru e got mondo joma lawou kik yudu. Ponduru kuno kuom ndalo adek nyaka giduogi; eka udhi nyime giwuodhu."
Jogi nowachone niya, "Kwongʼ ma isemiyo wakwongʼore godo ok otweyowa,
makmana, chiengʼ mwadonjo e pinyni, to nyaka itwe tol makwarni e dirisa kama ilorowanie, kendo nyaka ikel wuonu gi minu, oweteni gi joodi duto ei odi.
Ka dipo ni ngʼato owuok e odi modhi e yore mag mier, rembe enobed e wiye owuon; ok enobed wachwa. To ne ngʼatno manobed kodi ei ot, rembe nobedi e wiwa ka dipo ni lwedo moro nomule.
Makmana, ka dipo ni iwacho gino ma watimo, to inigonywa kuom kwongʼruok mane iketowa wakwongʼore godo."
Nowachonegi niya, "Wawinjore! Kendo mondo obed kaka uwachono."
Omiyo ne ogologi mi gidhi. Bangʼe notweyo tol makwar e dirisa.
Kane gisea, negidhi nyaka e gode mi gidak kuno kuom ndalo adek, manyaka joma ne lawogi otieko manyo kuonde duto ka giluwo yo mi gidwogo ma ok giyudogi.
Eka jonon piny ariyogi nolor oa e gode. Negingʼado aora, mi gidhi ir Joshua wuod Nun, kendo giwachone gigo duto mane otimorenigi.
Negiwachone Joshua niya, "Adiera, Jehova Nyasaye osechiwo pinyni duto e lwetwa, bende jogo modak e pinyno kihondko osemako nikech wan."

items.text: Jo-Israel ongʼado Aora Jordan
Gokinyi mangʼich Joshua kod jo-Israel duto nowuok koa Shitim, mi gidhi nyaka e aora Jordan, negibiro kanyo kapok giidho loka.
Bangʼ ndalo adek jotelo nowuotho e kuonde kambi duto,
ka gimiyogi chike niya, "Ka uneno ka Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, otingʼ gi jodolo, ma jo-Lawi, to nyaka uwuog oko e kuonde muchungʼie mondo uluwe.
Bangʼe ubiro ngʼeyo yo mudhiyoe, nikech ne pok uluwo yorni nyaka nene. Makmana, beduru mochwalore gi sandugno, madirom fut alufu ariyo mia ochiko gi piero abich gadek; kendo kik usud machiegni kode."
Joshua nokone oganda Israel niya, "Pwodhreuru, nikech kiny Jehova Nyasaye biro timo gigo miwuoro e kindu."
Joshua nowachone jodolo niya, "Kawuru Sandug Muma mar singruok kendo utel kode e nyim ji." Omiyo ne gikawe mi gidhi nyimgi.
Kendo Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Kawuono abiro tingʼi malo e wangʼ jo-Israel duto, eka ginyalo ngʼeyo ni An kodi mana kaka ne an gi Musa.
Nyis jodolo matingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok ni, 'Ka uchopo e geng pige mag aora Jordan, to dhiuru kendo uchungʼ ei aora.' "
Joshua nowachone jo-Israel niya, "Biuru kae kendo uchik itu ne weche Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
Kawuononi ubiro neno ranyisi ni Nyasaye mangima nikodu kendo enoriemb e nyimu jo-Kanaan, jo-Hiti, jo-Hivi, jo-Perizi, jo-Girgash, jo-Amor kod jo-Jebus.
Ne, Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto biro dhi nyimu nyaka aora Jordan.
Koro omiyo, yier ji apar gariyo koa e dhout Israel, ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot.
E sa ma jodolo motingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ma en Ruoth Nyasaye mar piny duto, nonyon aora Jordan, pige-ge mamol koluwo aora tir nochungʼ kogingore ka pith."
Omiyo ka ji noke oa e kambi mag-gi mondo gingʼad aora Jordan, jodolo motingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok notelo nyimgi.
Aora Jordan koro notimo ataro kuonde duto nyaka ndalo mag keyo. Omiyo ka jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok nochopo e aora Jordan mi tiendegi omulo geng aora,

pige mane mol koa malo nochungʼ. Nogingore malo kaka pith, e dala miluongo ni Adam man but Zarethan. Pi mane mol kadhi e nam mar Araba (ma tiende ni Nam Chumbi) nochungʼ chuth, omiyo ji nongʼado modhi loka komachielo, momanyore gi Jeriko.
Jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye nochungʼ motegno e lowo motwo e dier aora Jordan, nyaka ogendini mag jo-Israel notieko kadho ka giwuotho e lowo motwo.

items.text: Kane ogendini duto otieko ngʼado aora Jordan, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya,
"Yier ji apar gariyo e kind jogi, ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot,
kendo ikonegi mondo gikaw kite apar gariyo e dier aora Jordan yo korachwich koma jodolo ochungoe kendo gitingʼ-gi mi giketgi piny kama gidhi dakie otieno ma kawuono."
Omiyo Joshua noluongo ji apar gariyo mane oseyiero koa kuom jo-Israel, ngʼato achiel koa e dhoot ka dhoot,
kendo nowachonegi niya, "Dhiuru e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nyaka uchop e dier aora Jordan. Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka kaw kidi e goke, kaluwore gi kwan mar dhout Israel,
mondo obed kaka ranyisi e dieru. E ndalo mabiro, ka nyithindu openjou ni, 'Kitegi nyiso angʼo?'

To nyisgiuru kaka pi aora Jordan noduono kane Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kadho. Kane ongʼad kode aora Jordan, to pige mag aora Jordan noduono. Kitegi mondo obed rapar ni jo-Israel nyaka chiengʼ."

Omiyo jo-Israel notimo kaka Joshua nochikogi. Negikawo kite apar gariyo koa e dier aora Jordan, kaluwore gi kwan mar dhout Israel, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nokone Joshua; kendo negitingʼogi nyaka kama negibuoroe, kanyo negiketogie piny.
Joshua nochano kite apar gariyogo mane ni e dier aora Jordan kama jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok nosechungʼe kendo kitego pod ni kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.

Koro jodolo mane otingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok nodongʼ kochungʼ e dier aora Jordan nyaka ji notieko timo gik moko duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Joshua, mana kaka Musa nochiko Joshua. Ji nokadho mapiyo nono kadhi,
kendo bangʼ kane gisekadho giduto, eka jodolo bende nokadho modhi loka komachielo kotingʼo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka ji duto neno.
Jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase nongʼado ka gimanore gi gige lweny e nyim jo-Israel, mana kaka Musa nosechikogi.
Ji madirom alufu piero angʼwen mane moikore ni lweny mondo gikedi, nongʼado loka kocha e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nyaka e pewe mag Jeriko.
E odiechiengʼno, Jehova Nyasaye notingʼo Joshua malo e nyim jo-Israel, mi gimiye luor ndalo duto mag ngimane, mana kaka negimiyo Musa luor.
Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya,
"Chik jodolo motingʼo Sandug Muma mondo giwuog oko mar aora Jordan."
Omiyo Joshua nochiwo chik ni jodolo niya, "Wuoguru oko mar aora Jordan."

Kendo jodolo nowuok oko e aora kotingʼo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye. Kadiemo wangʼ kapok giketo tiendegi e lowo motwo, to pige mag aora Jordan noduogo e wangʼe mi ochako mol mogingore kaka chon.
E odiechiengʼ mar apar gariyo mar dwe mokwongo, ji noa e aora Jordan mi ochokore Gilgal e tongʼ ma yo podho chiengʼ mar Jeriko.
Kendo Joshua nochungo kite apar gariyogo Gilgal, ma gin kite mane ogolo e aora Jordan.
Nowachone jo-Israel niya, "E ndalo mabiro ka nyikwau nopenj wuoneu ni, 'Kitegi nyiso angʼo?'
To nyisgiuru ni, 'Jo-Israel nongʼado aora Jordan kawuotho e lowo motwo.'

Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu notwoyo aora Jordan e nyimu nyaka ukalo loka kocha. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu notimo ni aora Jordan mana gima notimone Nam Makwar e ndalo mane otwoye e nyimu nyaka ne ungʼado loka kocha.
Notimo kamano mondo ji duto manie piny ongʼe ni lwet Jehova Nyasaye nigi teko kendo mondo omi uluor Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kinde duto."

items.text: Oter jo-Israel nyangu Gilgal

Kane ruodhi duto ma jo-Amor modak yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan to gi ruodhi duto mag jo-Kanaan modak e dho nam nowinjo kaka Jehova Nyasaye notwoyo aora Jordan e nyim jo-Israel nyaka negingʼado, chunygi nobwok kendo ne gionge gi chir mar chomo jo-Israel tir.
E sechego Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Piag pelni mabith mondo ichak terogo jo-Israel nyangu."
Omiyo Joshua nopiago pelni mabith mi otero jo-Israel nyangu kama iluongo ni Gibeath Haraloth.
Gima omiyo notimo kamano en nikech ji duto mane oa Misri; ma gin jogo mahikgi noromo kedo e lweny, notho e thim ka gisewuok gia Misri.
Jogo duto mane oa Misri noseter nyangu, makmana joma nonywol e thim ka gisea Misri ema ne pod ok oter nyangu.

Jo-Israel nosewuotho e thim kuom thuolo maromo higni piero angʼwen manyaka ji duto mahikgi oromo kedo e lweny mane giwuokgo Misri nosetho nikech ne ok giseluoro Jehova Nyasaye. Jehova Nyasaye nosekwongʼorenegi ni ok gininee piny mane osingo ne kweregi mondo omigi, piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich.
Omiyo yawuotgi mane onywol bangʼe ka gin e thim ema ne Joshua otero nyangu. Ne pod ok otergi nyangu nikech ne oyudo kapod giwuotho e thim.
Bangʼ kane ogandani duto oseter nyangu, ne gidongʼ e kambi nyaka ne gichango.
Bangʼ mano, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Kawuono asetieko ajara mar jo-Misri kuomu." Omiyo kanyo iluongo ni Gilgal nyaka chil kawuono.
Godhiambo mar odiechiengʼ mar apar angʼwen mar dweno, jo-Israel nochokore Gilgal e pewe mag Jeriko kendo negitimo nyasi mar Pasaka.
Kinyne bangʼ Pasaka, mana godiechiengno, negichamo bath nyak mar piny kaka, makati ma ok oketie thowi gi chamb abula.
Bangʼ odiechiengʼ achiel kane gisechamo chiemo moa e pinyno, chiemb manna ne ok ochako biro ni jo-Israel nikech e higano negichamo mana nyak mar Kanaan.
Jeriko opodho
Ka koro Joshua ne chiegni chopo Jeriko, nongʼiyo nyime mi oneno ngʼato mochungʼ kotingʼo ligangla e lwete. Joshua nosudo machiegni kode mopenje niya, "In jakorwa koso jasikwa?"

Ngʼatno nodwoke niya, "Ok an maru kata mar wasiku, to asebiro kaka jatend lweny mar Jehova Nyasaye." Omiyo Joshua nopodho auma e nyime gi luor, mi openje niya, "En wach mane ma ruodha nigodo ni jatichne?"
Jatend lweny mar Jehova Nyasaye nodwoko niya, "Gol wuoche manie tiendi, nikech kama ichungoeni en Kama Ler." Omiyo Joshua notimo kamano.

items.text: Koro Jeriko nolor motegno nikech jo-Israel kendo onge ngʼama ne nyalo wuok oko kata donjo iye.
Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Joshua niya, "Ne, asechiwo Jeriko gi ruodhe e lweti, kaachiel gi jolweny mage.
Lworuru dala maduongʼno dichiel ka un gi giu mag lweny kendo timuru ma kuom ndalo auchiel.
Beduru gi jodolo abiriyo motingʼo turumbete molos gi tunge imbe e nyim Sandug Muma. E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo, lworuru dala maduongʼno nyadibiriyo, ka jodolo goyo turumbetego.
Ka uwinjogi ka gigoyo turumbetegi matek, to ket ji duto ogo koko matek; bangʼe ohinga mar Jeriko nopodh piny kendo ji duto nodonj e iye."
Omiyo Joshua wuod Nun noluongo jodolo mowachonegi niya, "Tingʼuru Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo beduru gi jodolo abiriyo kotingʼo turumbete e nyime."
Eka nochiwo chik ne ji niya, "Dhiuru nyime! Lworuru dala maduongʼ, ka jolweny momanore gi gige lweny otelo e nyim Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye."
Kane Joshua osewuoyo gi ji, jodolo abiriyo mane otingʼo turumbete abiriyo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye nowuotho ka gigoyo turumbete, kendo Sandug Muma mar Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ne luwo bangʼ-gi.
Jolwenygo notelo e nyim jodolo mane goyo turumbete, to moko ne luwo bangʼ Sandug Muma, kendo e kindeno duto turumbete ne ywak.
Makmana Joshua nosiemo ji niya, "Kik uywag ywak mar lweny, kik utingʼ dwondu malo, bende kik uwach wach moro amora nyaka odiechiengʼ ma anakonue mondo ugo koko. Bangʼe eka unukogi!"
Omiyo negikawo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gilworogo dala maduongʼno dichiel. Bangʼe ji noduogo e kambi margi mi otienono ginindo kanyo.
Joshua nochiewo gokinyi mangʼich kinyne kendo jodolo nokawo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye.

Jodolo abiriyo mane otingʼo turumbete abiriyo nodhi nyime, ka gipangore e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo ka gigoyo turumbete. Ji momanore gi gige lweny notelo e nyimgi, to moko ne luwo bangʼ Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye ka turumbete dhi nyime gi ywak.
E odiechiengʼ mar ariyo negilworo dala maduongʼno dichiel bangʼe gidok e kambi kendo negitimo kamano kuom ndalo auchiel.
To chiengʼ mar abiriyo, ne gichiewo kogwen mi gilworo dala maduongʼno nyadibiriyo e yo machalre gi mamoko ka. Chiengʼno kende ema negilworo dala maduongʼno nyadibiriyo.
E sa mane gilwore mar abiriyo ka jodolo ne pod goyo turumbete matek, Joshua nochiko ji kawacho niya, "Koguru matek, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou dala maduongʼni!
Dala maduongʼni duto, to gi gik moko duto manie iye nyaka wene Jehova Nyasaye. Makmana Rahab, mochot, to gi jogo duto manie ode ema nongʼwon-ne, nikech nopando joma ne waoro mane obiro nono piny.
To beduru mabor gi gigo mowene Jehova Nyasaye, mondo kik ukel kethruok ne un uwuon kuom gimoro amora kuomgi. Ka ok kamano to unumi kambi mar jo-Israel bed mar kethruok kendo ukel chandruok kuome.
Fedha gi dhahabu duto, kod gigo molos gi mula kod molos gi nyinyo owal ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo nyaka tergi kar keno mare."
Kane ogo turumbete, to ji ne goyo koko matek, kendo ka turumbete noywak, mi ji nogoyo koko matek, to ohinga mar Jeriko nopodho, omiyo ngʼato ka ngʼato nodonjo e dala maduongʼno mi gikawe.
Negiwalo dala maduongʼno ni Jehova Nyasaye ma giketho gimoro amora kendo ginego gi ligangla ngʼato angʼata madichwo kata madhako, jomatindo kata joma oti, dhok gi rombe kod punde.
Joshua nowachone jonon piny ariyogo niya, "Dhiuru e od Rahab kendo ukele kaachiel gi joodgi duto, kaluwore gi singruok mane uketo kode."
Omiyo rawere mane odhi nono pinyno nodhi Jeriko e od Rahab mi ogole kaachiel gi wuon-gi, min-gi, owetene kod joodgi duto. Negigolo anywolane duto oko mi giketogi oko mar kambi jo-Israel.
Bangʼe ne giwangʼo dala maduongʼno duto, to gi gimoro amora manie iye, makmana fedha gi dhahabu, gi gik molos gi mula kod molos gi nyinyo noketi e kar keno mar od Jehova Nyasaye.
Kamano Joshua noreso Rahab, dhako ma ochot, kaachiel gi anywolane nikech en ema nopando jonon piny mane Joshua ooro Jeriko kendo Rahab nodak e dier jo-Israel nyaka chil kawuono.
E sechego Joshua nolando kwongʼ makende niya, "Kwongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nobed kuom ngʼat manitem gero dala maduongʼ mar Jeriko kendo kama:
"Koketo mise mare,
to wuode makayo notho,
to kochungo dhorangeyege;
to wuode mogik notho."
Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye ne nigi Joshua kendo humbe nolandore e pinyno duto.

items.text: Richo mar Akan

Jo-Israel ne ok obedo jo-ratiro kaluwore gi gik mane owal ni Jehova Nyasaye. Ngʼat mane nyinge Akan wuod Karmi, ma wuod Zabdi, ma wuod Zera, mar dhood Juda nokawo moko kuom gik mane owalgi. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nobedo gi mirima gi jo-Israel.

Kane Joshua ooro ji koa Jeriko mondo odhi Ai, mantiere but Beth Aven yo podho chiengʼ mar Bethel nokonegi niya, "Dhiuru kendo utim nonro ma lingʼ-lingʼ mar gwengʼno." Omiyo jogo nodhi mi ginono Ai lingʼ-lingʼ.
Kane gidwogo ir Joshua, negiwachone niya, "Ji duto ok onego dhi kedo gi jo-Ai. To or ji alufu ariyo kata adek mondo odhi okawe kendo kik oket ji obed mool nikech nitiere mana ji manok kuno."
Omiyo ji madirom alufu adek ema nodhi, to jo-Ai noriembogi,
mi ji madirom piero adek gauchiel nonegi. Ne giriembo jo-Israel koa e dhoranga dala maduongʼ nyaka kama nitiere kite mopa kendo neginegogi e holo. Mano nomiyo kihondko nogoyogi ma gipodho.
Bangʼe Joshua noyiecho lepe mi opodho auma e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, moriyo kanyo nyaka odhiambo. Jodong Israel bende notimo kamano kendo ne giolo buru e wigi.

Joshua nowacho niya, "Yaye, Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, ere gima omiyo isekelo jogi loka mar aora Jordan mana ni mondo ichiwgi e lwet jo-Amor mondo itiekgi? Mad ne gik mane wan-go loka cha romwa kendo wasik kuno!
Yaye, Ruoth Nyasaye, en angʼo ma dwawachi ka jo-Israel oseriemb gi wasikgi kama?
Jo-Kanaan gi jopinyni mamoko biro winjo kuom wachni kendo gibiro monjowa mi gitiekwa e pinyni. Angʼo ma nitim mondo ires nyingi maduongʼni?"
Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ni Joshua niya, "Chungʼ malo! Angʼo ma ikulone wiyi piny ka?
Jo-Israel osetimo richo, kendo giseketho singruokna mane achikogi mondo giriti. Gisekawo bath gik moko mane owal, gisekwalo, giseriambo, kendo gisekawo gigo mokwer ma giriwo gi gig-gi giwegi.
Mano emomiyo jo-Israel ok nyal loyo wasikgi; giloko ngʼegi kendo giringo nikech oseketgi gir kethruok. Ok anabed kodu makmana ka uketho gigo manie dieru mowal ni kethruok.

"Aa malo mondo inyis jo-Israel opwodhre kinyisogi ni, 'Pwodhreuru kuikoru ni odiechiengʼ ma kiny nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel wacho kama: Gik mowal ne Jehova Nyasaye nitie e dieru, yaye Israel, omiyo kapod ok ugolo gigo kuomu, to ok unulo wasiku.

" 'Wuoguru gokinyi dhoot ka dhoot. Dhoot ma Jehova Nyasaye noyier biro biro e nyime anywola ka anywola, to anywola ma Jehova Nyasaye noyier biro biro e nyime dala ka dala, kendo dala ma Jehova Nyasaye noyier biro biro e nyime ngʼato ka ngʼato.
Ngʼatno mani maki gi gigo mowal notieki gi mach, kaachiel gi gige duto, nikech oseketho singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo osetimo gima mono e piny Israel!' "
Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Joshua noluongo jo-Israel gi dhoutgi, kendo Juda noyier.
Anywola mar Juda nobiro, mi oyier joka Zera. Joka Zera nobiro ot ka ot mi od Zabdi ema noyier.
Kane ogolo ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom joka Zabdi, to Akan wuod Karmi, ma wuod Zimri, ma wuod Zera mar dhood Juda ema noyier.
Bangʼ mano, Joshua nowachone Akan niya, "Wuoda, mi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel duongʼ gi pak. Nyisa gima isetimo kendo kik ipanda."
Akan nodwoke niya, "En adier! Asetimone Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel richo. Ma e gima asetimo:

Kane aneno gik miketho kaka njora maber moa Babulon, gi fedha ma pekne dirom kilo ariyo, to gi dhahabu ma pekne oromo nus kilo, to chunya nogombogi mi akawogi kendo apandogi e bwo lowo ei hemba ka fedha ema oket piny mogik."
Omiyo Joshua nooro joote mi giringo e hema kendo ne giyudogi mana kaka gin, kopandgi e hembe, ka fedha ema oket piny mogik.
Negigolo gigo koa e hema, mi gikelogi ni Joshua kod jo-Israel duto kendo gipedhogi oko e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.

Bangʼ mano Joshua, kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto nokawo Akan ma nyakwar Zera, gi fedha, gi njora, gi dhahabu, yawuote kod nyige, dhok, punde kod rombe, hembe kod gigo duto ma en godo mi giterogi nyaka e holo mar Akor.
Joshua nowacho niya, "Angʼo momiyo isekelo masira machal kama kuomwa? In bende Jehova Nyasaye biro keloni masira."
Bangʼe jo-Israel duto nochielo Akan kod joge gi kite, kendo ne giwangʼe kaachiel gi joge.
Bangʼ mano ne gidhuro kite kuom Akan, ma mano pod ni kamano nyaka chil kawuono. Eka mirima mar Jehova Nyasaye norumo. Kuom mano kanyo pod iluongo ni Holo mar Akor nyaka chil kawuono.

items.text: Ai okethi
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Kik iluor, kendo kik chunyi nyosre. Kaw jolweny duto mondo udhi umonj Ai, nimar asechiwo e lwetu ruodh Ai, joge, dalane maduongʼ kod pinye.
Timneuru Ai kod ruodhe mana kaka ne utimone Jeriko kod ruodhe, to wangʼni oyienu kawo gigo mane giyudo e yor mecho kaachiel gi jamni. Monjuru dala maduongʼno gi yo katoke."
Omiyo Joshua kod jolweny duto nowuok mondo gimonj Ai. Noyiero joge alufu piero adek molony e lweny mi oorogi oko gotieno komiyogi chik niya,
"Winjuru. Nyaka umonj dala maduongʼno gi yo katoke. Kik udhi mabor ahinya. Un duto nyaka uikru.
An kod jogo duto man koda, to biro dhi nyime e dala maduongʼ, to ka jogo obiro mondo omonjwa kaka negitimo motelocha, to wabiro ringo waa irgi.
Gibiro luwo bangʼwa nyaka wawuondgi mi giwuog oko mar dala maduongʼ, mi giniwach e chunygi ni, 'Ne, giringowa mana kaka ne giringowa motelo.' Omiyo seche mwaringogino
nyaka uwuog kuma upondoe kendo ukaw dala maduongʼno. Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro ketogi e lwetu.
Ka usekawo dala maduongʼno, to uwangʼe gi mach. Timuru gima Jehova Nyasaye osechiko kendo nyaka une ni utimo gik ma achikou."
Eka Joshua noorogi ma gidhi gipondo e kind Bethel gi Ai, ma en yo podho chiengʼ mar Ai, kendo otienono nosiko gi ji kanyo.
Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Joshua nochoko jolweny mage duto ka en kaachiel gi jodong Israel wuotho e nyimgi kadhi Ai.
Jolweny duto mane ni kode ne wuotho ka gichomo dala maduongʼ nyaka negichopo machiegni kode. Negigero kambigi yo nyandwat mar Ai, ka holo ni e kindgi kod dala maduongʼ.
Joshua nokawo ji madirom alufu abich mooro yo podho chiengʼ mar Ai mondo opond e kind Bethel kod dala maduongʼno.
Kuom mano thoth jolweny nobworo yo nyandwat mar dala maduongʼno, to joma nopondo ne ni yo podho chiengʼ. Otienono Joshua to nonindo e holo.

Kane ruodh Ai oneno ma, en kod ji duto mar dala maduongʼ nowuok oko mapiyo nono gokinyi mangʼich mondo girom kod jo-Israel e lweny kama omanyore gi Araba. To ne ok ongʼeyo ni kar pondo noseketi e ngʼe dala maduongʼno.
Joshua kod jo-Israel duto nowuondore ni ologi, mi giringo ka gichiko thim.
Chwo duto ma Ai nowuok mondo olaw Joshua gi joge, to kane gilawogi kamano, to ne gichwalore mabor gi dala maduongʼno.
Onge ngʼama nodongʼ Ai kata Bethel mane ok olawo jo-Israel. Ne giweyo dala maduongʼ nono ka gilawo jo-Israel.
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Siem yo Ai gi tongʼ mitingʼo e lwetino, nikech e lweti abiro chiwoe dala maduongʼno." Omiyo Joshua nosiemo tongʼe kochiko Ai.
E seche mane otimo ma, jogo mane opondo noa malo piyo ka giringo gidonjo e dala maduongʼ. Bangʼ kane gisekawe, ne giwangʼe mana gisano.

Jo-Ai nongʼiyo chien ma gineno ka iro dhwolore e dala maduongʼ kochiko polo, makmana ne gionge gi thuolo mar pondo e yo moro amora nikech jo-Israel mane osebedo kawuondore ni ringo kochiko thim nolokore kod jogo mane lawogi.
Kane Joshua kod jo-Israel noneno ka joma nopondo osekawo dala maduongʼ kendo iro bende ne dhwolore kanyo, negilokore mi gimonjo jo-Ai.
Jogo mane opondo bende nowuok oko mar dala maduongʼ moromo kodgi kendo omonjogi, omiyo nogengʼnegi e diere ka jo-Israel ni koni gi koni. Jo-Israel notiekogi pep maonge ngʼama notony kata achiel.
Ruodh Ai kende ema negimako kangima kendo negitere ir Joshua.
Kane jo-Israel ne osetieko nego jo-Ai duto mane ni e pap kod mane ni e thim kama ne giselawogie, kendo kane gisenegogi duto gi ligangla, jo-Israel nodok Ai mi ginego jogo mane odongʼ kuno.
Jo-Ai duto machwo kod mamon alufu apar gariyo notho chiengʼno.
Joshua ne ok owe siemo Ai gi tongʼ mane otingʼo e lwete nyaka Israel notieko ji duto mane odak Ai.
Jo-Israel to nokawo jamni gi mwandu mane giyako mar dala maduongʼno mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Joshua.
Omiyo Joshua nowangʼo Ai mi okete obedo pith mongingore mar kethruok kendo pod en kamano nyaka chil kawuono.

Ne onego ruodh Ai mi oliere gi tol e yath kama noriyoe nyaka odhiambo. Kane ochopo odhiambo, Joshua nogolo chik mondo ogol ringre oko e yath kendo lware piny e dhoranga dala maduongʼ. Nodhur kuome kite mangʼeny ma pod ni kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.
Otim singruok mar Sandug Muma e Got Ebal
Eka Joshua nogero kendo mar misango e got Ebal ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel,

mana kaka Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko jo-Israel. Nogere kaluwore gi gima nondiki e kitap Chik mar Musa niya, Kendo mar misango moger gi kite ma ok opa, gi gir nyinyo. Ewi kendono ema negichiwone Jehova Nyasaye misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok.
Joshua nondiko chik Musa e kitego e nyim jo-Israel.

Jo-Israel duto, jopinje mamoko kod jopinyno machalre, ka gin gi jodong-gi, gi jotendgi kod jongʼad bura nochungʼ e bath Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye koni gi koni, ka gimanyore gi jo-Lawi ma gin jodolo. Nus mar jo-Israel nochungʼ kochomo got Gerizim, to nus mar jo-Israel mamoko nochungʼ kochomo got Ebal mana kaka Musa ma jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko chon kane ochiwo nonro mar gwedho jo-Israel.
Bangʼ mano, Joshua nosomo weche mag chik ma gin, gweth gi kwongʼ mana kaka ondikgi e Kitap Chik mar Musa.
Onge chik Musa mane Joshua oweyo ma ok osomo ni kanyakla mar Israel duto, kaachiel gi mon, gi nyithindo, kod jopinje mamoko mane odak e diergi.

items.text: Jo-Gibeon owuondo jo-Israel

Ruodhi duto mane odak yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan nowinjo humb wechego; mane gin ruodhi moa e tiend gode mag pinyno, gi ruodhi moa yo podho chiengʼ mar gode gi mago moa e wedhe mag Nam Mediterania kaachiel gi ruodhi moa Lebanon (mane gin ruodhi mag jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod mago mag jo-Jebus);
ruodhigo noriwore giduto mondo giked gi Joshua kod jo-Israel.
Kata kamano, kane jo-Gibeon owinjo gima Joshua notimone Jeriko kod Ai,
negiparo mondo giwuonde. Negidhi kaka jogo man-gi punde motingʼo ogunde moti gi piende divai moti kendo obaw.
Jogi norwako wuoch moyiech kod lewni moti. Makati mane gin-go duto nokethore.
Eka negidhi ir Joshua e kambi man Gilgal mi giwachone Joshua kod jo-Israel niya, "Wawuok e piny mabor, omiyo yie watim kodu winjruok."
Jo-Israel nowacho ni jo-Hivi niya, "To ka dipo ni udak kodwa machiegni, ere kaka dwa los kodu winjruok?"
Negiwachone Joshua niya, "Wan jotichu."
To Joshua nopenjogi niya, "Un ngʼa gini to bende ua kanye?"
Negidwoko niya, "Jotichni oa e piny mabor ahinya nikech humb Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi. Wasewinjo humb gik mane otimo Misri,
kendo gigo duto mane otimone ruodhi ariyo mag jo-Amor man yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, ma gin Sihon ruodh Heshbon kod Og ruodh Bashan, mane odak Ashtaroth.
Omiyo jodongwa kod ji duto modak e pinywa nowachonwa kama, 'Kawuru gik mudhiyo godo e wuoth, dhiuru kendo urom kodgi ma uwachnegi niya, "Wan jotiju, losuru kodwa winjruok." '
Neuru makati mwatingʼogi, ne giliet ka wachako wuoth, to koro sani gikethore.
Piend divai mane wapongʼo bende ne nyien, to koro neye kaka giyiech. Lepwa kod wuochewa bende oseti nikech wuoth marabora ahinya."
Jotelo moko mag jo-Israel nobilo chiemb jogo ka ok gipenjo Jehova Nyasaye wach.
Omiyo Joshua noketo winjruok mar kwe kodgi mondo oyienegi gidag kodgi, kendo jotelo ne opwodho ma ka gikwongʼore.
Ndalo adek bangʼ kane giseloso winjruok gi jo-Gibeon, jo-Israel nowinjo ni jogo gin mana joma odak kodgi machiegni.
Omiyo jo-Israel nowuok, to odiechiengʼ mar adek negichopo e miechgi madongo kaka: Gibeon, Kefira, Beeroth, kod Kiriath Jearim.
Jo-Israel ne ok omonjogi, nikech jotend kambi nosesingore ka kwongʼore kodgi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach jo-Israel.
Kata kamano, ji duto nongʼur gi jotendgi,
to jotelogo duto nowacho niya, "Wasemiyogi singruok marwa e nying Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, omiyo koro ok wanyal mulogi.
Ma e gima wabiro timonegi: 'Wabiro wegi gidagi mondo kik mirima bi kuomwa nikech waketho kwongʼruok mane wasingonegi.' "
Negidhi nyime kagiwacho niya, "Wegi gidagi, mondo gibednwa jobar yien gi joumb pi ni jowa duto." Omiyo jotelo norito singruok margi.
Eka Joshua noluongo jo-Gibeon kendo owachonegi niya, "Angʼo momiyo ne uwuondowa ka uwacho ni, 'Wadak mochwalore kodu,' to kuom adier udak mana butwa?
Un joma okwongʼ! Ok unuwe tiyonwa kaka jobar yien gi joumb pi e od Nyasacha."

Negidwoko Joshua niya, "Jotichni notimo kamano nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi nochiko Musa jatichne mondo omiu pinyni duto kendo uneg ji duto modakie. Omiyo ne waluor nikech un, kendo mano ema nomiyo watimo kamano.
Koro to wan e lweti. Timnwauru gimoro amora muneno ni ber kendo longʼonu."
Omiyo Joshua nokonyogi kuom jo-Israel ma ok ginegogi.

E odiechiengʼno noketo jo-Gibeon obedo jobar yien gi joumb pi ni jo-Israel duto kendo ni tich kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye kama Jehova Nyasaye biro yiero. Kendo mano e gima gin nyaka chil kawuono.

items.text: Chiengʼ ochungʼ kar tiende
Eka Adoni-Zedek ruodh Jerusalem nowinjo ni Joshua osekawo Ai mi okethe chuth kendo onego ruodhe mana kaka nosetimone Jeriko kendo ni jo-Gibeon osetimo winjruok mar kwe gi jo-Israel mi gidak butgi.
En gi joge ne gibuok ahinya kuom wachni nikech Gibeon ne en dala maduongʼ mongirore, mana kaka achiel kuom mier madongo maka ruoth. Ne oduongʼ moloyo Ai, kendo joge duto ne gin jokedo mabeyo.
Omiyo Adoni-Zedek ruodh Jerusalem nokwayo Hoham, ruodh Hebron, Piram ruodh Jarmuth, Jafia ruodh Lakish kod Debir ruodh Eglon niya,
"Biuru mondo ukonya monjo Gibeon nikech oseloso kwe kod Joshua gi jo-Israel."
Eka ruodhi abich mar jo-Amor; ruodhi ma Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakish to gi Eglon noriwo jolwenjgi kaachiel. Negidhi kod jolweny mag-gi mi gimonjo Gibeon kendo gikedo kodgi.
Jo-Gibeon nooro wach ni Joshua e kambi man Gilgal niya, "Kik ijwangʼ jotichgi. Bi irwa piyo mondo ireswa! Konywa nikech ruodhi jo-Amor duto moa e piny manie wi got oseriwore mondo omonjwa."
Omiyo Joshua kaachiel gi jolweny mage mathuondi nowuok Gilgal mapiyo nono mondo odhi oresgi.
Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Kik iluorgi; asechiwogi e lwetu. Onge kata ngʼata achiel kuomgi mabiro sirou."
Kane gisewuotho otieno duto ka gia Gilgal, Joshua nomonjogi apoya.

Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo gichalo joma orundore e nyim jo-Israel, mine giloyogi gi loch maduongʼ e Gibeon. Jo-Israel nolawogi ka giluwo yo madhi Beth Horon mi ginegogi ma gichopo kodgi nyaka Azeka kod Makeda.

E kinde mane giringo e nyim jo-Israel e yo moa Beth Horon kadhi Azeka, Jehova Nyasaye nolwaro pe madongo kuomgi koa e polo kendo thothgi nomedo tho nikech peno nonego ji mangʼeny moloyo mago mane jo-Israel onego gi ligangla.
E odiechiengʼ mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiwo jo-Amor ni jo-Israel, Joshua nowachone Jehova Nyasaye e nyim jo-Israel niya,
"Yaye wangʼ chiengʼ, chungʼ kar tiendi ewi Gibeon,
to in dwe, chungʼ mana ewi holo mar Aijalon."
Omiyo wangʼ chiengʼ nochungʼ kar tiende,
to dwe bende ne ok osudo,
nyaka oganda mar jo-Israel nochulo kuor kuom wasikgi,
mana kaka nondike e Kitap Jashar.
Wangʼ chiengʼ nosiko kochungʼ e polo kuom thuolo madirom odiechiengʼ achiel.
Onge odiechiengʼ machal gi ma manosebetie ma Jehova Nyasaye nowinje kwayo mar dhano. Adier, adier Jehova Nyasaye ne kedo ni jo-Israel!
Bangʼe Joshua noduogo gi jo-Israel duto e kambi man Gilgal.
Ruodhi abich mag Amor onegi
Koro ruodhi abichgo noringo kendo gipondo e rogo mantiere Makeda.
Kane owach ne Joshua ni ruodhi abichgo nopondo e rogo mar Makeda,
nowacho niya, "Dinuru dho rogono gi kidi maduongʼ kendo uket jomoko kanyo mondo orite.
Un to kik uchungʼ kanyo, lawuru wasiku, monjgiuru kua gichien kendo kik uwegi gichop e miechgi madongo, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osechiwogi e lwetu."
Omiyo Joshua kod jo-Israel notiekogi chuth makmana joma tin ema nodongʼ e miechgi madongo mochiel kod ohinga.
Jolweny duto noduogo ir Joshua e kambi man Makeda maonge hinyruok moro, kendo onge ngʼama nowuoyo marach kuom jo-Israel.
Joshua nowacho niya, "Yawuru dho rogono kendo ugol ruodhi abichgo oko mi ukelgi ira."
Omiyo negigolo ruodhi abichgo oko mi gikelogi, ne gin ruodh Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakish kod Eglon.
Kane gisekelo ruodhigi ne Joshua, noluongo jo-Israel duto kendo owachone jotend lweny mane obiro kode niya, "Biuru ka kendo unyon ngʼut ruodhigi." Omiyo negibiro mi ginyono ngʼutgi piny.
Joshua nowachonegi niya, "Kik uluor, kendo kik chunyu nyosre. Beduru motegno kendo gi chir. Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye biro timo ne wasigu duto ma ubiro kedogo."
Bangʼe Joshua nomonjogi mi onego ruodhigo kendo olierogi e yien abich. Nowegi ka giliero e yiendego nyaka odhiambo.
Kane chiengʼ osepodho, Joshua nogolo chik mondo olor ringregi e yiende mane oliergie kendo odirgi e rogo kama negisepondoe. Negidino dho rogono gi kite madongo, ma pod ni kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.

E odiechiengno Joshua nokawo Makeda. Notieko dala maduongʼno kod ruodhe gi ligangla kendo otieko ngʼato angʼata mane ni e iye. Onge ngʼama notony kanyo. Notimone ruodh Makeda mana kaka notimone ruodh Jeriko.
Olo mier madongo man milambo
Eka Joshua kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nodhi Libna koa Makeda mi omonje.

Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo dala maduongʼni bende kod ruodhe e lwet jo-Israel. Dala maduongʼni to gi jogo duto modak e iye Joshua nonego gi ligangla. Onge ngʼama notony kanyo. Notimone ruodhgi mana kaka notimone ruodh Jeriko.
Eka Joshua kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nodhi Lakish koa Libna; mi gimonje.
Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo Lakish ne jo-Israel, to Joshua to ne okawe e odiechiengʼ mar ariyo. Dala maduongʼno kod ji duto modak kanyo nonego gi ligangla, mana kaka ne otimone Libna.
Kuom mano, Horam ruodh Gezer nobiro mondo okony Lakish, to Joshua noloye kaachiel gi jolweny mage maonge ngʼama notony.
Eka Joshua gi jo-Israel mane ni kode nodhi Eglon koa Lakish mi gimonje.
Ne gikawe odiechiengʼ nogono mi ginego ji duto kendo giketho gimoro amora mangima manie iye, mana kaka negisetimone Lakish.
Eka Joshua gi jo-Israel mane ni kode nodhi Hebron koa Eglon, mi gimonje.
Negikawo dala maduongʼno mi ginego ruodhe kod gimoro amora mangima mane ni kuno kaachiel gi mago mane nitie e mier matindo mokiewo kode. Onge ngʼama notony, mana kaka ne otimone Eglon.
Eka Joshua gi jo-Israel mane ni kode noduogo mi omonjo Debir.

Negikawo dala maduongʼno, ruodhe kod mier matindo mokiewo kode mi ginegogi. Ji duto mane odak kanyo negitieko chuth kendo onge joma notony. Negitimone Debir kod ruodhe mana kaka negitimone Libna gi ruodhe, to gi Hebron.

Omiyo Joshua nokawo gwengʼno duto kaachiel gi piny manie got ma en Negev, e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, to gi kuonde mag pewe kaachiel gi ruodhigi duto. Onge joma notony. Notieko jogo duto mangima, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nosechiko.
Joshua nokawogi koa Kadesh Barnea nyaka Gaza kendo koa e gwenge duto ma Goshen nyaka Gibeon.
Joshua nomako ruodhigo duto kaachiel gi pinjegi e lweny achielno nimar Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nokedo ni joge.
Bangʼe Joshua noduogo gi jo-Israel duto e kambi man Gilgal.

items.text: Olo ruodhi ma yo nyandwat
Kane Jabin ruodh Hazor owinjo ma, nooro wach ne Jobab ma ruodh Madon, kod ruodhi mag Shimron gi Akshaf,
kod ruodhi mae piny gode ma yo nyandwat e Araba ma milambo mar Kinereth, e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ kod e Nafoth Dor mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.

Nooro wach bende ni jo-Kanaan man yo wuok chiengʼ kod podho chiengʼ, kaachiel gi jo-Amor, jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, kod jo-Jebus mantiere e piny gode; kendo ni jo-Hivi modak e tiend got Hermon e gwenge mag Mizpa.
Ne giwuok gi jolweny mangʼeny ka kuoyo manie dho nam ka gin-gi farese kod geche lweny mangʼeny.
Ruodhigi duto noriwo tekogi mi gichokore kanyakla e Sokni mag Merom, mondo giked gi jo-Israel.
Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya, "Kik uluorgi, nikech kiny sa machalo kama abiro chiwogi duto ne jo-Israel mi gineg-gi. Nyaka ungʼad odond tiend faresegi kendo uwangʼ gechegi."
Omiyo Joshua gi jolwenje duto nobiro momonjogi apoya e Sokni mag Merom mi gikedo kodgi,
kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwogi e lwet jo-Israel. Negiloyogi mi gilawogi nyaka dala maduongʼ mar Sidon, nyaka Misrefoth Maim kendo nyaka Holo mar Mizpa ma yo wuok chiengʼ, maonge joma notony.
Joshua notimonigi kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko. Nongʼado odond tiend farese kendo nowangʼo gechegi.
E sechego Joshua noduogo mi okawo Hazor kendo onego ruodhe kod ligangla. Hazor ema ne jatend pinjegi duto.
Ji duto mane ni e dala maduongʼno noneg gi ligangla. Negitiekogi pep maonge gima yweyo mane odongʼ, Hazor bende ne giwangʼo.
Joshua nokawo mier madongo gi ruodhigi mi ginegogi gi ligangla. Notiekogi pep, mana kaka Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko.
Kata kamano, jo-Israel ne ok owangʼo dala maduongʼ moro amora moger e gode mag-gi matindo makmana Hazor ma Joshua nowangʼo.
Jo-Israel noyako gik moko duto kod kweth jamni mag mier madongogi, kendo neginego ji duto maonge ngʼama notony kata achiel.
Kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo chik ni jatichne Musa, omiyo Musa bende nochiwo chik ne Joshua, mi Joshua notimo mano. Onge gima noweyo ma ok otimo kuom gigo duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa.
Omiyo Joshua nokawo pinyni duto; kaka, piny manie got, piny Negev duto, gwenge duto mag Goshen, tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, Araba kod gode duto mag Israel kaachiel gi pewe mag
Got Halak, machakore yo Seir, nyaka Baal Gad manie Holo mar Lebanon manie Got Hermon. Nomako ruodhigi duto mi onegogi.
Joshua nokedo gi ruodhigi duto kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
Onge dala maduongʼ moro amora mane otimo winjruok gi jo-Israel makmana jo-Hivi modak Gibeon. Joma odongʼ duto negikedogo.
Jehova Nyasaye owuon ema ne omiyo chunygi obedo matek mondo gitug lweny gi jo-Israel kendo mondo jo-Israel otiekgi chuth maonge ngʼwono mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.

E ndalono mane Joshua odhi kendo otieko jo-Anak moa e piny gode, ema bende notieke joma odak, Hebron, Debir kod Anab, mago moa e pinje gode mag Juda, to gi moa e pinje gode mag Israel. Joshua notiekogi duto kod miechgi.
Onge jo-Anak mane odongʼ e piny jo-Israel; makmana joma nodongʼ Gaza, Gath kod Ashdod.
Omiyo Joshua nokawo pinyno duto mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa, mi nochiwe kaka girkeni ni jo-Israel kaluwore gi migepe mag dhoutegi.
Bangʼe pinyni nobedo gi kwe.

items.text: Nying ruodhi mane olo
Magi e ruodhi mag pinje mane jo-Israel oloyo kendo mane gikawo gwengegi ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, kochakore e holo mar Arnon nyaka e Got Hermon, moriwo nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ mar Araba.
Negiloyo Sihon ma ruodh jo-Amor manodak Heshbon.
Pinye nochakore Aroer man but holo mar Arnon koluwo holono nyaka e Aora Jabok, manie tongʼ mar jo-Amon. Ma noriwo nyaka nus mar Gilead.
Bende norito yo wuok chiengʼ mar Araba kochakore e Nam mar Kinereth nyaka e Nam mar Araba (tiende ni, Nam Chumbi), to nyaka Beth Jeshimoth, bangʼe nyaka yo milambo e tiend gode mag Pisga.
Kendo gwenge mag Og ruodh Bashan, achiel kuom mago mogik mag jo-Refai, ma lochne ne nitie Ashtaroth kod Edrei.
Norito Got Hermon, Saleka, Bashan duto, nyaka e tongʼ mar jo-Geshur gi Maaka, kendo gi nus mar Gilead nyaka e tongʼ-gi gi Sihon, ruodh Heshbon.
Musa, jatich Jehova Nyasaye kod jo-Israel noloyogi kendo Musa ma jatich Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo pinygino ne jo-Reuben, jo-Gad gi nus mar dhood Manase mondo obed kaka girkeni mag-gi.

Magi e ruodhi mag pinyno mane Joshua kod jo-Israel oloyo yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan, kochakore Baal Gad mantie e Holo mar Lebanon nyaka Got Halak mochakore yo Seir. Pinjegi duto Joshua nochiwo kaka girkeni ni dhout Israel kaluwore gi dhoutgi kaka opog-gi mondo obed mag-gi.

Ne en piny gode, gi pinje mantiere e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, Araba, pewe manie tiend gode, gi thim kod Negev. Kuondego ema ne jo-Hiti, jo-Amor, jo-Kanaan, jo-Perizi, jo-Hivi kod jo-Jebus odakie.

Ruodh Gezer, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Debir, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Geder, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Horma, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Arad, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Libna, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Adulam, ngʼato achiel
Ruodh Makeda, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Bethel, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Tapua, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Hefer, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Afek, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Lasharon, ngʼato achiel,
Ruodh Madon, ngʼato achiel,

kod Ruodh Tirza, ngʼato achiel.
Ruodhi duto mane onegi ne oromo piero adek gachiel.

items.text: Kuonde mapok okaw e piny Kanaan
Ka Joshua noseti kendo hike koro noniangʼ, Jehova Nyasaye nowachone niya, "Iseti ahinya, to pod nitie kuonde madongo mar pinyni monego kaw.
"Kuonde modongʼ mapok okaw e magi:
"gwenge duto mag jo-Filistia gi jo-Geshur,

kochakore e Aora Shihor man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Misri nyaka e tongʼ Ekron man yo nyandwat, magi duto nokwan kaka jo-Kanaan. Kuonde mane jotelo abich mag Filistia orito ne gin, Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath kod Ekron;
magi ne gin mag jo-Avi
yo milambo;
pinje duto mag jo-Kanaan, kochakore Meara mar jo-Sidonia nyaka ochopo Afek, gi tongʼ mar jo-Amor;
e gwenge mag Gebal;
to gi Lebanon duto ma yo wuok chiengʼ, kaachiel gi Baal Gad manie tiend Got Hermon nyaka Lebo Hamath.

"Ne jogo duto modak kuonde motimo gode chakre Lebanon nyaka Misrefoth Maim, tiende ni, jo-Sidonia duto, an awuon abiro riembogi mondo giwene jo-Israel. Beduru gi adieri mar pogo ni jo-Israel pinyni kaka girkeni margi, mana kaka asechikoi.
Pogeuru kaka girkeni ni dhoudi ochikogo, kaachiel gi nus joka Manase."
Pok mar piny ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar Aora Jordan
Nus modongʼ mar joka Manase, gi jo-Reuben kod jo-Gad noseyudo girkeni mag-gi mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye osemiyogi yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan.
Nochakore Aroer koluwore gi holo mar Arnon, kendo koluwore gi dalano manie dier holono, mi oriwo gode duto mag Medeba mochopo nyaka Dibon,
bende nyaka mier matindo mar Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, mane jatelo Heshbon, mantiere e tongʼ mar jo-Amon.
Noriwo nyaka Gilead, gwenge jo-Geshur kod jo-Maaka, Got Hermon duto, kod Bashan duto, mochopo nyaka Saleka,
tiende ni, pinyruodh Og duto man Bashan, ma bende nosebedo gi loch e Ashtaroth gi Edrei. (To bende nobedo achiel kuom jo-Refai mogik.) Musa noloyogi mi okawo pinygi.
Makmana jo-Israel ne ok oriembo jo-Geshur gi jo-Maaka, omiyo pod gidak e dier jo-Israel nyaka chil kawuono.
To dhood Lawi ne ok omiyo girkeni, nikech chiwo mane ochiw kokalo e mach ne Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel e girkeni margi, mana kaka ne osingonigi.
Girkeni mane Musa omiyo dhood Reuben kaluwore gi anywola ka anywola e magi:
Tongʼ mar pinygi nochakore Aroer man but holo mar Arnon, kendo koa e dalano mantiere e dier holono nyaka Medeba,
gi Heshbon kaachiel gi mier matindo mantiere e pewe, kaka Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mefath,
Kiriathaim, Sibma, Zereth Shahar mantiere e got manie holo,
Beth Peor, pewe mag Pisga, kod Beth Jeshimoth,

mier matindo duto mantiere e pewe kod kuonde duto mag Sihon ruodh jo-Amor, ma bende norito Heshbon. Musa noseloyo Sihon ruodh jo-Amor kaachiel gi Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur gi Reba mane jodong jo-Midian. Jodongogo nodak e pinyno ka gin e bwo loch Sihon.
Koriwore gi jogo mane onegi e lweny, jo-Israel nonego bende Balaam wuod Beor, mane ja-nyakalondo.
Aora Jordan ema nobedo tongʼ mar joka Reuben. Pinyno kaachiel gi mier matindo mokiewo kodgi nobedo girkeni mar joka Reuben.
Girkeni mane Musa omiyo dhood Gad kaluwore gi anywola margi e magi:
Piny Jazer, mier matindo duto mag Gilead kod nus mar jo-Amon mochopo Aroer machiegni gi Raba;
kendo chakre Heshbon nyaka Ramath Mizpa gi Betonim, kendo kochakore Mahanaim nyaka piny Debir;

to pinygi mane ni e holo notingʼo Beth Haram, Beth Nimra, Sukoth, Zafon kod bath piny Sihon ruodh Heshbon modongʼ (pinygino neni yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan kendo Jordan nyaka Nam Kinereth nodoko tongʼ mare).
Pinyno kaachiel gi mier matindo mokiewo kodgi nobedo girkeni mar joka Gad.
Girkeni mane Musa omiyo nus mar dhood Manase, tiende ni, nus mar nyikwa Manase, kaluwore gi anywola ka anywola.
Pinygi nochakore Mahanaim, mokwako piny Og ruodh Bashan duto kod kuonde dak duto mag Jair man Bashan, to gi mier matindo piero auchiel,
bende nokawo nus mar jo-Gilead, gi Ashtaroth kod Edrei (ma gin mier madongo mag Og ruodh Bashan).
Magi e pok mane omi nyikwa Makir wuod Manase, tiende ni nus mar dhood Makir konchiel.
Ma e girkeni mane Musa ochiwo kane en e paw Moab nyaka loka aora Jordan, yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jeriko.
To ni dhood Lawi, Musa ne ok opogonigi girkeni, nikech Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, e girkeni margi, mana kaka nosesingonegi.

items.text: Pok mar piny ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar Aora Jordan
Koro magi e kuonde mane jo-Israel oyudo kaka girkeni e piny Kanaan, ma Eliazar jadolo, Joshua wuod Nun to gi jotend dhout Israel nopogonegi.
Girkeni mag-gi nochiw kuom goyo ombulu ni dhoudi ochiko gi nus, kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko kokalo kuom Musa.
Musa nosepogo yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan ni dhoudi ariyo gi nus kaka girkeni, to ne ok opogo jo-Lawi girkeni e dier ogendini moko,
nimar yawuot Josef ne osepogore mi obedo dhoudi ariyo ma gin, Manase gi Efraim. Jo-Lawi ne ok oyudo pok moro e pinyno makmana mier mag dak, to gi lege ma rombgi kod dhogi nyalo kwayoe.
Omiyo jo-Israel nopogo pinyno mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko Musa.
Hebron omi Kaleb
Eka jo-Juda nodhi ir Joshua Gilgal kendo Kaleb ma wuod Jefune ma ja-Kenizi nowachone niya, "Ingʼeyo gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Musa, ngʼat Nyasaye ka en Kadesh Barnea kuomi kod an.
Ne an ja-higni piero angʼwen kinde mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye noora ka aa Kadesh Barnea mondo anon pinyni, kendo naduogone wach kaka chunya noneno,
to owetena mane odhi koda nokelo wach mane onyoso chuny ji. To kata kamano, an to naluwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha gi chunya duto.
Omiyo odiechiengno Musa nokwongʼorena ni, 'E pinyno matiendi osenyono biro bedo girkeni magi kendo gi nyithindi nyaka chiengʼ, nikech useluwo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasacha gi chunyu duto.'

"Koro mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosingo, osemiya ngima kuom higni piero angʼwen gabich nyaka nowach ne Musa wachni, e kinde mane jo-Israel ne pod wuotho e thim. Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye oserito ngimana, makoro an gi higni piero aboro gabich!
Kata kawuono pod ategno mana ka kinde mane Musa ooracha, kendo pod an-gi ilo mar dhi oko mondo akedi mana kaka ne an ndalo cha.

Koro miya piny manie godni mane Jehova Nyasaye nosingona odiechiengʼ cha. In iwuon ni iwinjo ni jo-Anak ni kanyo kendo miechgi madongo ne lach kendo ochiel gohinga makmana Jehova Nyasaye kokonya to abiro riembogi oko mana kaka nowacho."
Eka Joshua nogwedho Kaleb wuod Jefune mi omiye Hebron kaka girkeni mare.
Omiyo Hebron osebedo mar Kaleb wuod Jefune ma ja-Kenizi nyaka aa chiengʼno, nikech noluwo Jehova Nyasaye, Nyasach Israel, gi chunye duto.
Chon ni luongo Hebron ni Kiriath Arba kaluwore gi Arba, mane jatelo maduongʼ e dier jo-Anak.
Bangʼe pinyno nobedo gi kwe.

items.text: Pok mar Juda
Piny mane opog ni dhood Juda gi ombulu, kaluwore gi anywola margi, nochopo nyaka e gwenge mag Edom, kendo nyaka yo milambo e thim mar Zin.
Tongʼ-gi ma yo milambo nochakore e giko mar Nam Chumbi ma yo milambo,
kongʼado milambo mar Akrabim, kodhi nyime nyaka Zin, kendo ochwe nyaka milambo mar Kadesh Barnea. Bangʼe to ne ongʼado Hezron nyaka Adar kendo gomo kochiko Karka.
Bangʼe ne okalo nyaka Azmon mi ochopo nyaka Wadi manie piny Misri kendo ochopo nyaka e dho Nam Mediterania. Ma e giko tongʼne ma yo milambo.
Tongʼ-gi ma yo wuok chiengʼ nochakore Nam Chumbi modhi nyaka dho aora Jordan.
Tongʼ-gi ma yo nyandwat nochakore kama aora Jordan donjogo e nam maduongʼ,
modhi malo nyaka Beth Hogla kendo odhi nyime yo nyandwat mar Beth Araba nyaka e kite mag Bohan ma wuod Reuben.

Tongʼno nodhi nyaka Debir koa e Holo mar Akor mi ogomo kochiko nyandwat nyaka Gilgal, mangʼiyore gi Pass mar Adumim mantiere yo milambo mar holono. Nodhi nyime koluwo dho aora mar En Shemesh mochopo nyaka En Rogel.

Bangʼe noluwo Holo mar Ben Hinom, kochomo pewe ma milambo mar dala maduongʼ mar jo-Jebus (tiende ni, Jerusalem). Koa kanyo noidho nyaka ewi got man yo podho chiengʼ mar Holo mar Hinom e giko mar Holo mar Refaim mantiere yo nyandwat.
Koa ewi got, tongʼno nochiko yo thidhna mag pige mag Neftoa, mowuok koa e mier matindo mag Got Efron kendo modhi nyaka Baala (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim).
Bangʼe tongʼno nogomo kochiko yo podho chiengʼ chakre Baala nyaka Got Seir, koluwo yo nyandwat mar pewe mag Got Jearim (tiende ni, Kesalon), modhi nyime nyaka Beth Shemesh kendo ongʼado nyaka Timna.
Nodhi nyaka yo nyandwat manie pewe mar Ekron kendo ogomo kochiko Shikeron, mi okalo nyaka Got Baala kendo ochopo Jabnel. Tongʼno nochopo nyaka e nam.
Tongʼ ma yo podho chiengʼ nochopo nyaka e dho Nam Maduongʼ.
Magi e tongʼ mar jo-Juda kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Bath piny Juda momi Kaleb
Kaluwore gi chik mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Joshua, nomiyo Kaleb wuod Jefune bath piny Juda miluongo ni, Kiriath Arba, ma tiende ni, Hebron. (Arba ne en kwar Anak.)
Kochakore Hebron, Kaleb noriembo jo-Anak adek, ma gin Sheshai, Ahiman kod Talmai ma gin nyikwa Anak.
Koa kanyo nodhi momonjo joma odak Debir (machon ne iluongo ni Kiriath Sefa).
To Kaleb nowacho niya, "Anachiw nyara Aksa mondo okendi gi ngʼatno manoked ma kaw Kiriath Sefa."
Othniel wuod Kenaz, ma owadgi Kaleb noloyo pinyno, omiyo Kaleb nomiye nyare Aksa mondo okendi.
Chiengʼ moro achiel kane obiro ir Othniel, nojiwe mondo okwa wuon mare puodho. Kane olor oa e pundane, Kaleb nopenje niya, "En angʼo midwaro ni mondo atimni?"
Nodwoko niya, "Timna ngʼwono makende. Nimar isemiya puodho man Negev, miya bende thidhna mar pi." Omiyo Kaleb nomiye thidhna ma malo kod mamwalo.
Ma e girkeni mar dhood Juda, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Mier matindo man yo podho chiengʼ ma nopogne dhood Juda man Negev kaachiel gi mago mogo tongʼ gi Edom ne gin:
Kabzel, Eder, Jagur,
Kina, Dimona, Adada,
Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
Zif, Telem, Biloth,
Hazor Hadata, Kerioth Hezron (tiende ni, Hazor),
Amam, Shema, Molada,
Hazar Gada, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
Hazar Shual, Bersheba, Biziothia,
Baala, Iyim, Ezem,
Eltolad, Kesil, Horma,
Ziklag, Madmana, Sansana,
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain kod Rimon. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo piero ariyo gochiko.
To mier mane nitiere e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ ne gin:
Eshtaol, Zora, Ashna,
Zanoa, En Ganim, Tapua, Enam,
Jarmuth, Adulam, Soko, Azeka,
Sharaim, Adithaim, kod Gedera (kata Gederothaim). Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo apar gangʼwen.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Zenan, Hadasha, Migdal Gad,
Dilean, Mizpa, Jokthel,
Lakish, Bozkath, Eglon,
Kabon, Lamas, Kitlish,
Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naama kod Makeda. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gauchiel.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Libna, Ether, Ashan,
Ifta, Ashna, Nezib,
Keila, Akzib kod Maresha. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo ochiko.
Ekron gi mier molworo bende ne margi.
Ashdod gi mier molwore bende ne margi kochakore yo podho chiengʼ mar Ekron.
Ashdod gi Gaza kod miechgi mochopo nyaka Wadi manie tongʼ-gi gi Misri, kendo koluwo nyaka dho Nam Maduongʼ bende ne margi.
Mier mamoko mane ni e got ne gin:
Shamir, Jatir, Soko,
Dana, Kiriath Sana (tiende ni, Debir),
Anab, Eshtemo, Anim,
Goshen, Holon, kod Gilo. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gachiel.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Arab, Duma, Eshan,
Janim, Beth Tapua, Afeka,
Humta, Kiriath Arba (tiende ni, Hebron), kod Zior. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo ochiko.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juta,
Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoa,
Kain, Gibea, kod Timna. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
Maarath, Beth Anoth kod Eltekon. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo auchiel.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Kiriath Baal (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim), kod Raba. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo ariyo.
Mier mane giyudo e thim ne gin:
Beth Araba, Midin, Sekaka,
Nibshan, Dala Maduongʼ mar Chumbi, kod En Gedi. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo auchiel.
Jo-Juda ne ok nyal daro jo-Jebus, mane odak Jerusalem; jo-Jebus gi jo-Juda pod odak kanyo nyaka chil kawuono.

items.text: Pok mar jo-Efraim gi jo-Manase
Piny mane opog ne Josef nochakore Aora Jordan man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Jeriko, koluwo i thim mochopo e gode man Bethel.
Nodhi nyime chakre Bethel (tiende ni, Luz), mi ongʼado gwengʼ jo-Arki mantiere Ataroth,
koridore yo podho chiengʼ nyaka e tongʼ jo-Jaflet mochopo nyaka e holo mar Beth Horon kendo nyaka Gezer, mogik e nam.
Omiyo Manase gi Efraim, ma nyikwa Josef, noyudo girkeni mag-gi.
To piny Efraim kaluwore gi anywola ka anywola ema:
Tongʼ mar pinye mane girkeni mare nochakore Ataroth Adar, ma yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Beth Horon Mamalo,
kendo odhi nyime nyaka e nam. Bende kochakore Mikmethath mantiere yo nyandwat ne ogondore kochiko yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Tanath Shilo, mochopo nyaka yo wuok chiengʼ mar Janoa.
Eka nodhi piny kochakore Janoa nyaka Ataroth gi Naara, momulo Jeriko mokadho e aora Jordan.
Kochakore gie tongʼ Tapua nodhi yo podho chiengʼ nyaka Kana Tavain kendo ogik e nam. Ma ema ne girkeni mar dhood Efraim, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Piny mane omi Efraim kaka girkenino bende notingʼo mier moko mane ni e gwengʼ Manase.
Ne ok gidaro jo-Kanaan mane odak Gezer. Nyaka chil kawuono jo-Kanaan pod odak gi jo-Efraim ka gitiyonegi kaka wasumbinigi.

items.text: Ma e pok mar dhood Manase, kaka wuod Josef makayo, tiende ni, mar Makir, wuod Manase makayo. Makir ne kwar jo-Gilead, ma norwako Gilead gi Bashan nikech jo-Makir ne gin jolweny mongʼere.
Omiyo pokni nowene joka Manase mane odongʼ, kaka, anywola mar Abiezer, Helek Asriel, Shekem, Hefer, kod Shemida. Magi e nyikwa Manase ma wuod Josef mamoko machwo kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Zelofehad ma wuod Hefer, ma wuod Gilead, ma wuod Makir, ma wuod Manase, ne onge yawuowi makmana nyiri kende, ma nying-gi ne gin: Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka gi Tirza.

Negidhi ir Eliazar jadolo kod Joshua wuod Nun, to gi jotelo mi giwachonegi niya, "Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Musa mondo opognwa girkeni e dier owetewa." Omiyo Joshua nomiyogi girkeni kaachiel gi owete wuonegi, kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye.
Pok mar Manase ne en lope apar kapok okwan piny Gilead kod piny Bashan mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar aora Jordan,
nikech nyi dhood Manase noyudo girkeni e kind owetegi. Piny jo-Gilead nobedo mar nyikwa Manase mamoko.
Piny Manase nochakore Asher nyaka Mikmethath mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Shekem. Tongʼno nochakore yo milambo mokawo nyaka joma odak En Tapua.
Manase nokawo piny Tapua, to Tapua owuon, mane nitiere e tongʼ Manase, nobedo mar jo-Efraim.

Eka tongʼno nodhi nyime yo milambo mochopo nyaka Kana Ravin. Ne nitiere mier matindo ma mek Efraim mane nitiere e dier mier matindo mag Manase, makmana tongʼ Manase ne nitiere yo nyandwat mar holo matut madiny kendo mogik e nam.
Yo milambo ne en piny Efraim, to yo nyandwat ne en mar Manase. Piny Manase nochopo e nam kendo mokiewo gi Asher yo nyandwat, to Isakar yo wuok chiengʼ.
E Isakar kod Asher, Manase ne nitie bende kod Beth Shan, Ibleam kod jo-Dor, Endor, Tanak kod Megido, kaachiel gi jogo mane odak machiegni kodgi, ngʼat mar adek e kwan-no ne en Nafoth.
Kata kamano, jo-Manase ne ok nyal kawo e mier matindogi, nikech jo-Kanaan noramo ni nyaka gidag kanyo.
Omiyo ka jo-Israel nodoko maroteke, negiketo jo-Kanaan obedo wasumbinigi mane ok giriembogi kata matin.
Joka Josef nowachone Joshua niya, "Ere gima omiyo isepogonwa kendo miyowa mana kamoro achiel kaka girkeni? Wasenyaa kendo Jehova Nyasaye osegwedhowa mogundho."
Joshua nodwokogi niya, "To ka usenyaa ahinya kamano kendo piny gode mag Efraim koro tinnu, kare koro dhiuru e bungu manie piny jo-Perizi kod jo-Refai mondo ubet kanyo obed maru."

Joka Josef to nodwoko niya, "Piny godeno ok oromowa, kendo jo-Kanaan duto modak e pawno nigi geche mag lweny ma tiendgi otimo nyinyo, kendo mago modak Beth Shan gi mier molwore kaachiel gi holo mar Jezreel bende nigi gechego."
To Joshua nowachone od Josef, ma gin Efraim kod Manase niya, "Usenyaa kendo un joma nigi teko. Ok unubed gi pok achiel kende,
to nyaka piny moyugno manie got bende. Beteuru nyaka kuma unyalo, to obiro bedo maru; kata obedo ni jo-Kanaan nigi geche nyinyo kendo gi tegno, pod unyalo riembogi."

items.text: Pogo kuonde mane odongʼ
Kanyakla duto mag jo-Israel nochokore Shilo ma giguro Hemb Romo kanyo. Pinyno nobedo e bwo lochgi,
makmana ne pod nitiere dhout Israel abiriyo mane pod ok oyudo girkeni margi.
Omiyo Joshua nowachone jo-Israel niya, "Ubiro rito nyaka karangʼo kapok uchako kawo mwandu mar piny mane Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach wuoneu, asemiyou?
Yieruru ji adek koa e dhoot ka dhoot. Abiro oorogi mondo gidhi ginon pinyno kendo gindik malongʼo kuom pinyno, kaluwore gi pok mar ngʼato ka ngʼato. Bangʼe, to gidwog ira.
Nyaka upog pinyni e migepe abiriyo. Jo-Juda nyaka dongʼ kargi man yo milambo kendo joka Josef bende odongʼ kargi man yo nyandwat.
Bangʼ ka usendiko malongʼo kuom migepe abiriyo mar pinyno, to ukelnagiuru kae kendo abiro pogonugi gi ombulu e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.

Kata kamano, jo-Lawi to ok noyud pok e dieru, nikech tichgi mar dolo ne Jehova Nyasaye e girkeni margi. To Gad, Reuben kod nus mar dhood Manase, to oseyudo girkeni margi e bath aora Jordan ma yo wuok chiengʼ nikech Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nosemiyogi."

E kinde mane jogi owuok mondo gidhi ginon piny, Joshua nomiyogi chik niya, "Dhiuru kendo utim nonro malongʼo mar pinyni kendo undik gik moko duto muyudo e iye. Bangʼe dwoguru ira kendo abiro miyou pok maru Shilo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye."
Omiyo jogo nowuok modhi koluwo dier piny tir. Negindiko gigo duto mane giyudo e pinyno e kitabu, e dala ka dala, e migepe abiriyo kendo mi gidwogo ir Joshua e kambi man Shilo.
Bangʼe Joshua nomiyogo pok margi Shilo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, kendo gikanyono nopogo jo-Israel pinyno kaluwore gi dhoutgi.
Pok mar joka Benjamin
Pok mar joka Benjamin, notimne anywola ka anywola. Kuonde mane opognigo ne ni e kind Juda gi Josef.
Tongʼ-gi ma yo nyandwat nochakore e aora Jordan, kochomo pewe man yo nyandwat mar Jeriko, mi oluwo piny godego kochomo yo podho chiengʼ nyaka ochomo e thim mar Beth Aven.
Koa kanyo nongʼado kodhi yo milambo mar pewe mag Luz (tiende ni, Bethel), modhi nyaka Ataroth Adar mantiere yo milambo mar Beth Horon Mamwalo.

Koa e got momanyore gi Beth Horon mantiere yo milambo, tongʼno nogomo kochomo yo podho chiengʼ mar godno, mogik Kiriath Baal (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim), ma en dala jo-Juda. Mano e tongʼ-gi ma yo podho chiengʼ.
Tongʼ ma yo milambo nochakore oko mar Kiriath Jearim mantiere yo podho chiengʼ, kendo tongʼno nochopo nyaka thidhna mar pi Neftoa.

Tongʼno nodhi nyaka e tiend got momanyore gi Holo mar Ben Hinom, kod yo nyandwat mar Holo mar Refaim. Nodhi nyime nyaka e Holo mar Hinom koluwo yo milambo mar pewe mar dala maduongʼ mar jo-Jebus kendo mochopo En Rogel.
Bangʼe nogomo kochiko yo nyandwat, modhi nyaka En Shemesh, kendo nyaka Geliloth, momanyore gi Adumim, kendo oridore kadhi piny nyaka Kit Bohan ma wuod Reuben.
Nodhi nyime nyaka yo nyandwat mar pewe mag Beth Araba mochopo nyaka Araba.
Eka nodhi kendo yo nyandwat mar pewe mag Beth Hogla mi owuok koa yo nyandwat mar dho Nam Chumbi, kama aora Jordan ochakore godo mantiere yo milambo. Mano e tongʼ-gi ma yo milambo.
Aora Jordan ne en tongʼ mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ.
Ma e kaka nopog ni anywola mar Benjamin pinygi.
Mier madongo mane dhood Benjamin nitierego kaluwore gi anywolagi e magi:
Jeriko, Beth Hogla, Emek Keziz,
Beth Araba, Zemaraim, Bethel,
Avim, Para, Ofra,
Kefa Amoni, Ofni kod Geba. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gariyo.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Gibeon, Rama, Beeroth,
Mizpa, Kefira, Moza,
Rekem, Irpil, Tarala,
Zela, Haelef, jo-Jebus (tiende ni, Jerusalem), Gibea kod Kiriath. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gangʼwen.
Magi e mier mane opog ni dhood Benjamin.

items.text: Pok mar joka Simeon
Pok mar ariyo nobiro ne dhood Simeon, kaluwore gi anywola margi. Girkeni margi ne nitiere e piny jo-Juda.
Notingʼo:
Bersheba (kata Sheba), Molada,
Hazar Shual, Bala, Ezem,
Eltolad, Bethul, Horma,
Ziklag, Beth Makaboth, Hazar Shusa,
Beth Lebaoth kod Sharuhen. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo apar gadek.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Ain, Rimon, Ether kod Ashan. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo angʼwen,
ka ok okwan mier matindo mokiewo kodgi mochopo nyaka Baalath Beer (ma bende iluongo ni Rama e piny Negev).
Magi e mier mane opog ne dhood Simeon kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Girkeni mar dhood Simeon nopognegi koa kuom pok mar jo-Juda, nikech pok mar Juda ne duongʼ mohewogi. Omiyo dhood Simeon noyudo pok margi koa e piny Juda.
Pok mar joka Zebulun
Pok mar adek ne mar dhood Zebulun kaluwore anywolagi.
Tongʼ mar pok margi nochopo nyaka Sarid.
Koa yo podho chiengʼ nochiko Marala mochopo nyaka Dabesheth, kendo oyarore kochomo holo matut mantiere but Jokneam.
Nogomo kochiko yo wuok chiengʼ koa Sarid nyaka e piny Kisloth Tabor kendo odhi nyime nyaka Daberath mi ogik Jafia.
Bangʼe nodhi nyime gi yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Gath Hefer kod Eth Kazin; bangʼe nowuok oko e Rimon mi ogomo yo Nea.
Bangʼ Nea, tongʼno nochomo yo nyandwat mochopo nyaka Hanathon bangʼe to ogik e holo mar Ifta El.
Pinyno notingʼo Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idala kod Bethlehem. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gariyo.
Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Zebulun kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Pok mar joka Isakar
Pok mar angʼwen nomi dhood Isakar kaluwore gi anywola margi.
Pinyni notingʼo:
Jezreel, Kesuloth, Shunem,
Hafaraim, Shion, Anaharath,
Rabith, Kishion, Ebez,
Remeth, En Ganim, En Hada kod Beth Pazez.
Tongʼ pinyno nochopo nyaka Tabor, Shahazuma gi Beth Shemesh, mi ogik nyaka aora Jordan.
Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gauchiel.
Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Isakar kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Pok mar joka Asher
Pok mar abich nomi dhoot Asher kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Pinygi nopogi kama:
Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaf,
Alamelek, Amad kod Mishal. To yo podho chiengʼ, tongʼ-gi nochopo Karmel gi Shihor Libnath.
Bangʼe tongʼno nochomo yo wuok chiengʼ mochopo nyaka Beth Dagon koluwo Zebulun gi Holo mar Ifta El, kochomo yo nyandwat nyaka Beth Emek gi Neyel kokalo e bath Kabul.
Nodhi nyaka Abdon, Rehob, Hamon kod Kana, mochopo nyaka Sidon Maduongʼ.
Bangʼe nodwok tongʼno chien nyaka Rama modhi nyaka e dala maduongʼ mar Turo mochiel gohinga, mogomo kochiko Hosa koluwo dho nam e gwengʼ mar Akzib,
Uma, Afek kod Rehob.
Giduto ne gin mier matindo kod gwenge piero ariyo gariyo.
Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Asher kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Pok mar joka Naftali
Pok mar auchiel nomi dhood Naftali, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Tongʼ-gi nochakore Helef modhi nyaka kar yien maduongʼ man Zananim, koluwo Adami Nekeb gi Jabnel mochopo Lakum kendo gikone ne en aora Jordan.
Tongʼno noluwo yo podho chiengʼ kokadho Aznoth Tabor kendo owuok Hukok. Gi yo milambo tongʼno nokiewo gi Zebulun, to yo podho chiengʼ nokiewo gi Asher; to yo wuok chiengʼ nokiewo gi aora Jordan.
Mier mane ochiel gohinga ne gin: Zidin, Zer, Hamath, Rakath, Kinereth,
Adama, Rama, Hazor,
Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath kod Beth Shemesh.
Giduto ne gin mier matindo kod gwenge apar gochiko.
Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Naftali, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Pok mar joka Dan
Pok mar abiriyo nomi dhood Dan, kaluwore gi anywola margi.
Kuonde mane opog-gi ne gin:
Zora, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,
Shalabin, Aijalon, Ithla,
Elon, Timna, Ekron,
Elteke, Gibethon, Baalath,
Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimon,
Me Jarkon kod Rakon, to gi kama omanyore gi Jopa.
To dhood Dan ne nigi pek kuom kawo pok mar pinygi, omiyo negidhi ma gimonjo Leshem mi gikawe, bangʼe ginegogi gi ligangla. Negidak Leshem kendo ma gichake ni Dan mane en kwargi.
Magi e mier matindo kod gwenge mane opog ne dhood Dan, kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Pok mar joka Joshua
Kane gisetieko pogo pinyno e migepe ka migepe, jo-Israel nomiyo Joshua wuod Nun pok e diergi,
mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko. Negimiye dalano mane okwayogi, ma en, Timnath Sera manie piny Efraim. Kuom mano, nogero dala kanyo modakie.
Magi e pok mane Eliazar jadolo, Joshua wuod Nun kod jotelo mag dhout Israel nopogo lowo gombulu ka gin Shilo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye e dhoranga Hemb Romo. Omiyo negitieko pogo pinyno.

items.text: Mier madongo mag tony
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Joshua niya,
"Kone jo-Israel oyier miechgi madongo mag tony, kaka ne asenyisou kokalo kuom Musa,
mondo ngʼato angʼata monego nyawadgi kobothne kendo ok dwarone nyalo biro kanyo mi oyud konyruok koa e lwet ngʼama dwaro chulone kuor.

"Ka oringo mi obiro e achiel kuom mier madongogi, to nyaka ochungʼ e dhorangach mar dala maduongʼ mondo owach malongʼo chandruok mare e nyim jotend dala maduongʼno. Bangʼ mano to girwake ei dalagi maduongʼno kendo gimiye kama odakie kodgi.
Ka ngʼat madwaro chulo kuor olawe, to kik gichiw ngʼatno modonjne, nikech ne onego nyawadgino ka ok ochano kendo ka oonge gi paro mar nege.
Nyaka odag e dala maduongʼ kanyo machop chiengʼ bura e nyim kanyakla kendo nyaka chop chiengʼ ma jadolo maduongʼ marito kanyo tho. Bangʼeno onyalo dok e dalane owuon, ma en dalano mane oringo koaye."
Omiyo negiwalo tenge Kedesh man Galili e piny Naftali manie got, gi Shekem e piny Efraim manie got kod Kiriath Arba (tiende ni, Hebron), e piny Juda ma bende ni e got.

To yo wuok chiengʼ mar Aora Jordan (e piny mamalo momanyore gi Jeriko) negiyiero Bezer manie thim kuom piny dhood Reuben gi Ramoth mantiere Gilead kuom piny dhood Gad, kod Golan mantiere Bashan e dhood Manase.

Ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak mora amora modak e diergi ma nonego ngʼato ka ok ochano kendo ka oonge gi paro mar nege mondo odhi e mier madongo mowal mar tony mondo kik neg-gi gi ngʼatno madwaro chulo kuor kapok otergi e bura e nyim kanyakla.

items.text: Mier matindo mag jo-Lawi
Bangʼe jotelo mag anywola mag dhout jo-Lawi nobiro ir Eliazar jadolo, Joshua wuod Nun, kod jotelo mag dhout anywola mamoko mag Israel,
kama iluongo ni Shilo ei Kanaan mi giwachonegi niya, "Jehova Nyasaye nochiko kokalo kuom Musa ni mondo imiwa dalano mondo wadagie, kod kuonde ma jambwa nyalo kwayoe."
Omiyo kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosechiko, jo-Israel nomiyo jo-Lawi mier matindogi kod kuonde kwath koa kuom pokgi giwegi.
Pok mokwongo nodhine jo-Kohath kaluwore gi anywola margi. Jo-Lawi mane nyikwa Harun jadolo nopog mier matindo apar gadek koa e dhout Juda, Simeon kod Benjamin.
Nyikwa Kohath mane odongʼ nopog mier matindo apar koa e anywola mar dhout Efraim, Dan kod nus mar dhood Manase.
Nyikwa Gershon nopog mier matindo apar gadek koa e anywola mar dhood Isakar, Asher, Naftali, to gi nus mar dhood Manase man Bashan.
Nyikwa Merari kaluwore gi anywola margi, noyudo mier matindo apar gariyo koa e dhood Reuben, Gad kod Zebulun.
Omiyo jo-Israel nopogo jo-Lawi mier matindogi kod kuonde kwath, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye nochiko kokalo kuom Musa.
Koa e dhout Juda kod Simeon negipogo mier matindogi gi nying-gi kama:
mier matindogi ne gin mek nyikwa Harun mane oa kuom jo-Kohath e anywola mar jo-Lawi, nikech pok mokwongo nomigi.
Ne gimiyogi Kiriath Arba (tiende ni, Hebron), gi kuonde kwath, mantiere e piny manie got mar Juda. Arba ne en kwar jo-Anak.
To puothe kod gwenge molworo dala maduongʼ ne gisemiyo Kaleb wuod Jefune kaka pok mare.
Omiyo nyikwa Harun jadolo negimiyo Hebron (ma en dala maduongʼ mar tony mar ngʼama oneko), Libna,
Jatir, Eshtemoa,
Holon, Debir,
Ain, Juta kod Beth Shemesh, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo ochiko koa e dhoudi ariyogi.
To koa e dhood Benjamin ne gimiyogi
Gibeon, Geba,
Anathoth kod Almon, kaachiel gi kuondegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Mier matindo duto mane omi jodolo ma nyikwa Harun, ne gin apar gadek, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath.
Anywola mar jo-Kohath mar dhood Lawi mane odongʼ nopog mier matindo koa e dhood Efraim.
E yo kama otingʼore mar Efraim nomi
Shekem (ma en dala maduongʼ mar tony ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko) kod Gezer,
Kibzaim kod Beth Horon, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Bende koa e dhood Dan nomigi
Elteke, Gibethon,
gi Aijalon kod Gath Rimon, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Koa e nus mar dhood Manase nomigi
Tanak kod Gath Rimon, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo ariyo.
Mier matindogi apar kod legegi mag kwath nomi anywola jo-Kohath mane odongʼ.
Mier mane omi jo-Gershon maa e dhood Lawi ne gin:
Koa e nus mar dhood Manase, nomigi,
Golan mantiere Bashan (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), kod Be Eshtara, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo ariyo.
Koa e dhood Isakar, nomigi,
Kishion, Daberath,
Jarmuth kod En Ganim, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Koa e dhood Asher nomigi,
Mishal, Abdon,
Helkath kod Rehob, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Koa e dhood Naftali, nomigi,
Kedesh man Galili (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), gi Hamoth Dor kod Kartan, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo adek.
Mier matindo duto mar anywola jo-Gershon ne gin apar gadek, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath.
Anywola jo-Merari (ma gin jo-Lawi mamoko) nomi:
Koa e dhood Zebulun nomi:
Jokneam, Karta,
Dimna kod Nahalal, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Koa e dhood Reuben nomi:
Bezer, Jahaz,
Kedemoth kod Mefath, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Koa e dhood Gad nomi:
Ramoth mantiere Gilead (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), gi Mahanaim,
Heshbon kod Jazer, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath. Giduto ne gin mier matindo angʼwen.
Mier matindo duto mane opog ni anywola jo-Merari mane gin jo-Lawi modongʼ, ne gin apar gariyo.
Mier matindo mag jo-Lawi e piny mane jo-Israel okawo ne gin piero angʼwen gaboro giduto, kaachiel gi legegi mag kwath.
Mier matindogi moro ka moro ne nigi legegi mag kwath e alworagi, kendo ma ne en adiera ne mier matindogi duto.
Omiyo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Israel pinje duto mane osingore ni enomi kweregi, kendo ne gikawogi mi gidakie.
Jehova Nyasaye nomiyogi kwe, mana kaka ne osesingore ni enomi kweregi. Onge wasikgi moro amora mane omonjogi; kendo Jehova Nyasaye nochiwo wasikgi duto e lwetgi.
Onge singruok moro amora mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo jo-Israel mane ok otimonegi; moro ka moro nochopo kaka nowacho.

items.text: Dhoudi ma yo wuok chiengʼ odwogo dala
Eka Joshua noluongo jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase
mowachonegi niya, "Usetimo gigo duto mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye ochiko, kendo bende useluora e gigo duto mane achikou.
Kuom kinde mangʼeny nyaka kawuononi, pok ujwangʼo oweteu, to usetimo tich mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu omiyou.
Ka koro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyo oweteu kwe kaka ne osesingo, doguru e miechu e piny mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye nomiyou e bath aora Jordan kocha.

To beduru motangʼ kurito puonj kod chike mane Musa jatich Jehova Nyasaye omiyou kama: heruru Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, wuothuru e yorene duto, luoruru chikene, padreuru kuome kendo tineuru gi ngimau duto."
Bangʼe Joshua nogwedhogi mi oorogi, kendo negidok e miechgi.

To ne nus mar dhood Manase, Musa nomiyogi piny mantiere Bashan, to nus machielo mar dhoodno, Joshua nomiyogi piny mantiere yo podho chiengʼ mar aora Jordan kaachiel gi owetene. Kane Joshua osegologi mondo gidog e miechgi, nogwedhogi kowacho niya,
"Ero udok e miechu gi mwandu mangʼeny kaka kweth mar jamni mathoth, fedha, dhahabu, mula gi nyinyo, kod lewni mangʼeny kendo neuru ni upogone oweteu gigo mane upeyo kuom wasiku."
Omiyo jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase noweyo jo-Israel Shilo mantiere Kanaan, mondo gidogi Gilead, pinygi giwegi, mane giyudo kaluwore gi chik Jehova Nyasaye kokalo kuom Musa.
Kane gibiro Geliloth but aora Jordan e piny Kanaan, jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase nogero kendo mar misango machiegni gi aora Jordan.
To ka jo-Israel nowinjo ni negisegero kendo mar misango e tongʼ Kanaan kama iluongo ni Geliloth but aora Jordan yo kor jo-Israel,
oganda duto mar Israel nochokore Shilo mondo gidhi giked kodgi.
Omiyo jo-Israel nooro Finehas wuod Eliazar jadolo, e piny Gilead, ir jo-Reuben, jo-Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase,
mi nodhi gi jotelo apar mag dhout Israel kamoro ka moro ochungʼ ne dhoot ka dhoot.
Kane gidhi Gilead, ir dhood Reuben, Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase, negiwachonegi niya,
"Oganda duto mar Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Ere gima omiyo uketho winjruok maru gi Nyasach Israel? Ere gima omiyo ungʼanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye mi ugero kendo mar misango ni un uwegi e yor wangʼ teko?
Donge richo mane watimo Peor oromo? Nyaka chil kawuono kum mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyowa pok orumo!
Uparo ni kumno ne yot ma pod udhi nyime mana ne ngʼanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye?
" 'Ka dipo ni pod ukwedo Jehova Nyasaye kawuono, to kiny iye biro wangʼ gi jo-Israel duto.

Ka piny ma ukawoni odwanyore, to biuru e piny Jehova Nyasaye, kama ogurie hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye, kendo mondo udag kodwa e pinyni. To kik ukwed Jehova Nyasaye kata mana wan bende ka ugero kendo mar misango ne un uwegi, makmana kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kende.
Donge uparo kaka Akan wuod Zera notimo richo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, momiyo oganda jo-Israel duto okum? Ok en kende ema notho nikech richone.' "
Jo-Reuben, Gad kod nus mar dhood Manase nodwoko jotend anywola mag jo-Israel niya,

"Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye Maratego! Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye Maratego! Ongʼeyo gik moko duto! Israel mondo ongʼe! Ka dipo ni ma notim e yor ngʼanyo, kata bedo maonge gi luor ne Jehova Nyasaye, to kik ingʼwon-nwa kawuono.

Ka dipo ni wagero kendowa mar misango owuon mondo waa ir Jehova Nyasaye kendo mondo wachiw misango miwangʼo pep kod chiwo mar cham, kata ni wachiw misango mar lalruok kuome, to mad Jehova Nyasaye kumwa kaka joma osetimo richo.
"Ooyo! Ne watimo kamano nikech chiengʼ moro nyikwawa nyalo wachone nyikwau ni, 'En angʼo ma wanyalo timo gi Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel?
Jehova Nyasaye oseketo aora Jordan mondo opog kindwa kodu, un joka Reuben kod joka Gad! Uonge kod pok moro kuom Jehova Nyasaye.' Omiyo nyikwau nyalo miyo nyikwawa weyo luoro Jehova Nyasaye.
"Mano emomiyo nwawacho ni, 'Waikreuru kendo wager kendo mar misango, to ok mar misango miwangʼo pep, kata ni sewni mamoko.'

To kata kamano, ma onego obed ranyisi e kindwa kodu to gi tiengʼ mabiro bangʼwa, ni wabiro lamo Jehova Nyasaye e kare maler mar lemo ka wachiwone misango miwangʼo pep, misengini mamoko kod misango mar lalruok. Bangʼe ndalo mabiro nyikwau ok nowach ne nyikwawa ni, 'Uonge gi pok kuom Jehova Nyasaye.'

"To ne wawacho niya, 'Ka dipo ni giwachonwa ma, kata ne nyikwawa to wabiro dwoko kama: Neuru kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye, mane kwerewa ogero, mondo obed kaka ranyisi e kindwa kodu, to ok ni chiwo misango miwangʼo pep.'

"Mad wabed mabor gi ngʼanyone Jehova Nyasaye, mi walokre waa kuome kawuono ka wagero kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, chiwo mar cham kod misengini mamoko moloyo kendo mar misango mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa mochungʼ e nyim kare maler."
Kane Finehas jadolo kod jotend gwengʼ, ma gin jotend anywola mar jo-Israel, nowinjo gima Reuben, Gad kod Manase nowacho, negibedo gi mor.

Kendo Finehas wuod Eliazar ma jadolo, nowachone Reuben, Gad kod Manase niya, "Kawuono wangʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye nikodwa, nikech ok usetimo gima Jehova Nyasaye okwero. Kuom mano usereso jo-Israel kuom kum mar Jehova Nyasaye."
Bangʼe Finehas wuod Eliazar ma jadolo, kod jotelo noduogo Kanaan koa e romogi gi jo-Reuben kod jo-Gad mane nitiere Gilead kendo ne gidwokone jo-Israel wach.
Negimor kuom winjo wachni kendo negipako Nyasaye. Ne ok gichako giwuoyo kendo kuom dhi kedo kodgi mondo giketh piny ma dhood Reuben kod Gad odakie.
Dhood Reuben kod Gad nomiyo kendo mar misangono nying machalo kama: Ranyisi e Kindwa ni Jehova Nyasaye en Nyasaye.

items.text: Joshua ogoyo oriti ne jotelo
Bangʼ kinde moko ka Jehova Nyasaye nosemiyo jo-Israel kwe e kindgi gi wasikgi duto, noyudo ka koro Joshua oseti kendo ne en gi higni moniangʼ,
omiyo noluongo jo-Israel duto kaachiel gi jodong-gi, jotelo, jongʼad bura kod jotelo mamoko kendo mi owachonegi niya, "Aseti kendo hika oseniangʼ.
Un uwegi useneno gigo ma Jehova Nyasaye osetimo ni ogendinigi duto nikech un; ne en Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ema nokedonu.
Paruru kaka asepogo ni dhoutu pinje duto mag ogendini mane odongʼ kaka girkeni, ogendini mane aloyo, modak e kind aora Jordan kod Nam Maduongʼ mantiere yo podho chiengʼ.
Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu owuon biro riembo wasiku e nyimu. Omiyo riembgiuru gia e nyimu, kendo unukaw pinygi, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nosingonu.
"Beduru motegno ahinya; beduru motangʼ mondo ulu mago duto mondikie Kitabu mar Chik mar Musa, ma ok udok yo korachwich kata koracham.
Kik uriwru gi ogendini modongʼ e dieru, kik uluong nying nyisechegi kata kik ukwongʼru gi nying-gi. Kik utinegi kata kik ukulrunegi.
To nyaka umak Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu motegno, mana kaka usebedo ka utimo."
"Jehova Nyasaye oseriembo e nyimu oganda maduongʼ kendo maratego; kendo nyaka odiechiengni onge ngʼama oseloyou.
Ngʼato achiel biro lawo ji alufu achiel, nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kedonu, mana kaka ne osingonu.
Omiyo beduru motangʼ mondo uher Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
"To ka ungʼanyo mi uriworu kod jogo motony manie pinyni modongʼ e dieru kendo unywomoru kodgi,

to ngʼeuru ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ok nochak oriemb ogendini e dieru kendo. Jogo nobednu obadho gi ramaki, boka mi chwadogo ngʼeu, kendo kudho e wengeu, nyaka chop ulal nono uae pinyni, ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osemiyou.

"Koro sani adwaro dhi kuma ji duto manie piny dhiyoe. Ungʼeyo malongʼo gi chunyu duto ni onge singo moro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nomiyou ma pod ok otimo. Singo duto osetimo maonge modongʼ.
Mana kaka singo duto maber mar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osebedo adiera, omiyo Jehova Nyasaye biro kelo kuomu gigo maricho duto mobwogou godo, nyaka one ni otiekou pep e piny maberni ma osemiyou.

Ka uketho singruok mane kindu gi Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, mane ochikou, kendo mi udhi ma utiyo ne nyiseche manono kukulorunegi, to mirimb Nyasaye biro olore kuomu, kendo ubiro lal nono piyo e piny maber ma osemiyouni."
